name: Project configuration options
summary: Per-project option lists (note types, statuses, priorities and tags, capture tags, sheet and BIM types), with names and colours.

roles.note: Each option type has its own add, update and delete strings (for example add-note-type and update-capture-tags). Generic project-config strings are shown here.

actions.note: Also requires the option itself to allow it

nfr.statement: Maximum options per type per project.
nfr.open_question: Is there a practical limit (for example tags per project) that pickers and reports must handle?

requirements.title: Option names are unique per project, entity and type
requirements.statement: An option name is trimmed and can't be empty. Within one project it must be unique for the same entity and option type, so a note tag and a capture tag may share a name.

acceptance_criteria.given: A project with a note tag named Safety
acceptance_criteria.when: A user adds a capture tag named Safety, then another note tag named " Safety"
acceptance_criteria.then: The capture tag is saved, and the second note tag is rejected

requirements.title: Some options can't be renamed or recoloured
requirements.statement: Each option says whether it can be renamed, recoloured or deleted. An edit is refused if the option doesn't allow it, or if the new name clashes with another option of the same entity and type.
open_checks: The duplicate-name query doesn't visibly exclude the option being edited

acceptance_criteria.given: A built-in note status that can't be renamed
acceptance_criteria.when: A user tries to rename it

requirements.title: Options in use can't be deleted
requirements.statement: Deleting an option that notes or designs still use is refused, and the response lists the items using it. The HTTP request still succeeds. For tags, an option can remove the tag from notes first and then delete it.

acceptance_criteria.given: A note type used by three notes
acceptance_criteria.then: It is not deleted, and the response lists the three note IDs

requirements.title: Coloured options, created in place
requirements.statement: Users can give configuration options colours and create new options without leaving their current screen. Issue and task reports show options in their colours.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user on the configuration options page
acceptance_criteria.when: They give an option a colour
acceptance_criteria.then: The colour is applied, and existing notes using the option are unaffected otherwise

acceptance_criteria.when: They create a new tag from the tag picker
acceptance_criteria.then: The tag is created and applied without leaving the note
